div.head: Leis Wl 18
div.ab: Cil ki purgist femme a force, forfeit ad les menbres.
Ki purgist femme per forze, forfait ad. les membres.
De ui opprimentibus. Si quis mulierem ui oppresserit et uiolauerit, membrorum dampno punietur.
Cil ki purgist femme a force forfeit ad les menbres.
18. Wer mit Vergewaltigung einer Frau beiliegt, hat die [Viril]glieder verwirkt.
18. Whoever lies with a woman by violence has forfeited the [virile] members.
If anyone assaults a woman he shall suffer castration as a penalty.

note.seg: der Angelsächsische Annalist a. 1087 rühmt als Wilhelms I. Gerechtigkeit: Gif hwilc carlman hæmde wið wimman hire unðances, sona he forleas þa limu, þe he mid pleagode; und Wilhelm von Poitiers (ed. Giles 147): tutae erant a ui mulieres. Also vielleicht Spur eines Gesetzes

the Anglo-Saxon annalist, a. 1087, praises as an instance of William I’s justice: Gif hwilc carlman hæmde wið wimman hire unðances, sona he forleas þa limu, þe he mid pleagode; and William of Poitiers (ed. Giles 147): tutae erant a ui mulieres. So perhaps the trace of a law
Vgl. Gl Notzucht 7. 8. 11. Die Entmannung (d. 2) erklärt ohne Not aus Nord. Einfluss Steenstrup Danelag 60
Cf. Gl Notzucht 7. 8. 11. Steenstrup Danelag 60 needlessly explains the castration (see that word 2) by Norse influence
